name: skeleton_regularization_v1
hypothesis: Preserve the original coordinate information, but penalize memorization using mixed training inputs and targets.
selection: Same-user inner validation selects checkpoints; unseen-user outer validation is diagnostic only.
promotion: Require outer improvement on both folds without inner collapse before seed replication; otherwise reject. No automatic fusion or submission.
training_accuracy_caveat: With mixup, train/accuracy uses the primary label and is not directly comparable with unmixed training accuracy. Compare clean_train diagnostics instead.
mask_policy: Training filters absent skeleton clips. Mixing asserts every mask is exactly one, changes only the feature tensor, and never creates fractional masks. Both validation sets retain all clips.
